evidence_boundary: All six current-run experiments are local synthetic mechanism tests or CPython microbenchmarks. They are not live-FRANK, target-Qwen, production-database, Android or production-security estimates.

experiments.setup: Contracts used typed SET/ORDERED/MULTISET collection semantics. Mutations varied semantic-equivalent reordering/duplication, provenance-only changes, semantic changes and reader-view-only changes. Compared one provenance-bound contract hash, semantic-only hash and separated semantic/contract/view axes.
experiments.interpretation: One identity key cannot simultaneously answer executable semantic equality, exact committed-instance identity and emitted-view identity in this construction. Separate axes remove the constructed category errors. Zero errors are by construction for the implemented canonicalization and do not prove collision/security properties.

experiments.setup: Eight independently changing domains. Each operation depended on 1-4 domains (mean 2.049) and lasted 1-5 ticks. Compared no commit revalidation, required-domain revalidation and all-domain/global revalidation.
experiments.interpretation: In this constructed workload, scoped validation rejected every basis-invalid operation while a universal barrier rejected an additional 13.88% of all operations for unrelated domain changes. This supports operation-specific cross-store consistency as a target hypothesis, not a live rate estimate.

experiments.setup: Sampled cross-plane query fraction, write intensity and concurrency uniformly. Compared specialized stores, logically unified API over specialized stores, hybrid shared-canonical-plus-sidecars and physical monolith using explicit synthetic latency and common-mode-risk cost surfaces.

results.regime_observation: Physical monolith won most often in high-cross-plane/low-write/low-concurrency regimes; hybrid dominated latency wins under high concurrency or high writes in the chosen cost surface.

experiments.interpretation: The synthetic sweep rejects a one-size-fits-all physical-unification assumption: the preferred architecture changes with workload and risk weights. Absolute fractions depend on the chosen synthetic cost model and are not empirical database benchmarks.

experiments.setup: 50 modular domains, 5,000 base nodes, 20,000 derived nodes, mostly intra-domain dependencies with occasional cross-domain edges; each event changed five base nodes. Measured transitive affected derived set versus full recomputation over 2,000 events.
experiments.interpretation: Modularity can make change-propagation dramatically cheaper than full recomputation. The gain collapses as dependency connectivity increases; the graph was deliberately modular and is not a FRANK topology estimate.

experiments.setup: Twenty authentic candidates had four independent score signals. A top-5 plan used fixed weights; one weight was perturbed by +/-0.12 and renormalized while all candidate data remained unchanged.
experiments.interpretation: Selection can change materially while record bytes remain authentic. Query/selector plan identity therefore belongs in causal/provenance receipts whenever membership/ranking matters. A plan hash detecting mutation is an identity check, not proof that either plan is semantically correct.

experiments.setup: One record containing identifiers/role/tags plus a 256-float vector. Compared JSON dumps+loads roundtrip, creation of a compact tuple+memoryview handle, and SHA-256 over the float buffer.
experiments.interpretation: This isolates a potential serialization boundary: handle creation can be orders of magnitude cheaper than textual roundtrip in CPython. The operations are not semantically equivalent end-to-end; these numbers do not predict Rust/C/Android/FRANK latency and motivate a target-host Arrow/shared-memory benchmark only.

fresh_prior_measured_evidence.result: Nemotron-Mini-4B raw 4/12 -> COVE compiled 11/12; prompt tokens 458 -> 289 (-36.9%).
Raw L0 12/16; typed L1 13/16 with +81% prompt tokens; compact Clay-like arm failed output contract.
Role-reversed directed relations were more embedding-similar than role-preserving paraphrases in two constructed pairs.
Verified isolated multiline Python/generated-host execution; semantic executable identity separated from provenance-bound contract-instance identity after v0.1 failure.
